scenes.title: Две стороны ресторана  (Two Sides of a Restaurant)
scenes.summary: Max and bartender Kostya discuss the stark contrast between the glamorous front of the restaurant and the chaotic reality behind the kitchen doors.

scenes.title: Опоздание на смену  (Late for the Shift)
scenes.summary: Max arrives two hours late for his shift, allowing Chef Barinov to win a bet and assign Max to unload heavy deliveries all day.

scenes.title: Ошибка природы  (Freak of Nature)
scenes.summary: Waitress Nastya asks what a female head chef is called, prompting Chef Barinov to scoff at women chefs until she reveals a rival chef is in the dining room.

scenes.title: Где мой нож?  (Where Is My Knife?)
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov discovers his favorite knife has disappeared and halts all kitchen operations until it is found.

scenes.title: Японский нож  (The Japanese Knife)
scenes.summary: Anya and Senya quietly discuss why Chef Barinov is so protective of his irreplaceable Japanese blade.

scenes.title: Новый бармен  (The New Bartender)
scenes.summary: Max poses as the new bartender behind the bar counter when Anya arrives to order two espressos.

scenes.title: Тоже мне бармен  (Some Bartender You Are)
scenes.summary: Waitress Sasha catches Max making a mess at the bar and orders him back to the kitchen.

scenes.title: Спасти шефа  (Saving the Head Chef)
scenes.summary: Victoria warns that Barinov refuses to cook, so the kitchen crew debates making the fricassee themselves.

scenes.title: Хорошо или плохо?  (Good or Bad?)
scenes.summary: The cooks nervously watch the VIP dining guest taste their secret fricassee.

scenes.title: Гости просят шефа  (The Guests Want the Chef)
scenes.summary: Panic erupts in the kitchen when waitress Sasha informs Senya and Fedya that the guest has finished the fricassee and demands the head chef.

scenes.title: Визит к столу  (A Visit to the Table)
scenes.summary: Cleaner Ainura summons Barinov to the dining hall where rival chef Elena Sokolova compliments the fricassee but complains about the long wait.

scenes.title: Гнев шеф-повара  (The Head Chef's Wrath)
scenes.summary: Furious over his missing Japanese knife and the unauthorized cooking, Barinov storms into the kitchen and lies to the cooks that Elena hated the food.

scenes.title: Посторонний в баре  (An Outsider in the Bar)
scenes.summary: Vika discovers a strange man lingering behind the bar counter and furiously orders the bogus technician out of the restaurant.

scenes.title: Пропажа коньяка  (The Missing Cognac)
scenes.summary: Vika confronts Kostya about leaving the bar unattended, only for them to discover that an expensive bottle of vintage cognac has vanished.

scenes.title: В погоне за вором  (Chasing the Thief)
scenes.summary: Realizing the fake repairman stole the valuable cognac bottle, Kostya panics under Vika's fury and dashes out of the restaurant to catch the thief.

scenes.title: Пропавший коньяк  (The Missing Cognac)
scenes.summary: Outside the back entrance, bartender Kostya confronts the computer technician who stole the expensive cognac and threatens him with his boxing skills.

scenes.title: Один нормальный день  (One Normal Day)
scenes.summary: Exhausted by endless restaurant crises and missing cognac, Vika vents her frustration to waitress Sasha and begs for just one quiet, normal working day.

scenes.title: Матч на кухне  (Match in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov is glued to the kitchen television watching the intense Spartak vs CSKA soccer match as striker Ari takes a crucial shot on goal.

scenes.title: Неловкая ситуация  (An Awkward Situation)
scenes.summary: At the bar, Max accidentally punches Kostya over a misunderstanding; Kostya demands fresh orange juice to nurse his bruised nose while Chef Barinov yells at the kitchen staff.

scenes.title: Разговор в кабинете шефа  (Talk in the Chef's Office)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov summons sous-chef Lyova into his private office, furiously threatening to fire the entire staff unless his beloved missing fish knife is found immediately.

scenes.title: Опасная находка  (A Dangerous Find)
scenes.summary: Senya catches Max holding the Chef's missing knife and warns him of Barinov's wrath; in a panic, they agree to hide the knife inside a large fresh fish.

scenes.title: Ищите везде  (Look Everywhere)
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor Barinov scolds the staff about kitchen order and orders sous-chef Lyova to keep searching everywhere for the missing knife, suggesting it might even be inside a fish.

scenes.title: Спрячь нож  (Hide the Knife)
scenes.summary: In the dishwashing area, cleaner Ainura frantically warns kitchen worker Jindi to hide the chef's knife before Barinov sees it and loses his temper.

scenes.title: Меч крестоносца  (The Crusader's Sword)
scenes.summary: When a knife is found inside a baked fish served to guests, Max invents a historical legend of the Crusades to save the restaurant from scandal.

scenes.title: Две стороны медали  (Two Sides of the Coin)
scenes.summary: Vika tries to get Max fired by showing restaurant owner Dmitry a fight video, but Dmitry refuses, leading Max to reflect on changing relationships.
